component.name: AppRow
component.script:
sub init() th = LumenTheme() m.th = th m.top.translation = [0, th.rowY]
m.slider = m.top.createChild("Group") m.slider.id = "slider" m.tiles = m.slider.createChild("Group")
m.name = m.top.createChild("Label") m.name.id = "name" m.name.font = LumenFont("Manrope-ExtraBold", 28) m.name.color = th.white m.name.horizAlign = "center" m.name.width = 340 m.name.opacity = 0
m.slide = m.top.createChild("Animation") m.slide.duration = 0.24 m.slide.easeFunction = "inOutCubic" m.slideX = m.slide.createChild("Vector2DFieldInterpolator") m.slideX.fieldToInterp = "slider.translation" m.slideX.key = [0, 1]
m.nameIn = m.top.createChild("Animation") m.nameIn.duration = 0.26 m.nameIn.easeFunction = "outCubic" ni = m.nameIn.createChild("FloatFieldInterpolator") ni.fieldToInterp = "name.opacity" ni.key = [0, 0.23, 1] ni.keyValue = [0, 0, 1] m.namePos = m.nameIn.createChild("Vector2DFieldInterpolator") m.namePos.fieldToInterp = "name.translation" m.namePos.key = [0, 0.23, 1]
m.offset = 0 m.prevIndex = -1 end sub
sub build() m.tiles.removeChildrenIndex(m.tiles.getChildCount(), 0) list = [{ id: "lumen.memories", name: "Memories", type: "lumen" }] for each a in m.top.apps list.Push(a) end for list = savedOrder(list) list.Push({ id: "lumen.add", name: "Add app", type: "lumen" }) m.nodes = [] for i = 0 to list.Count() - 1 t = m.tiles.createChild("AppTile") t.iconBase = m.top.iconBase t.reduceMotion = m.top.reduceMotion t.app = list[i] if list[i].id = "lumen.memories" and m.top.photos <> invalid then t.photos = m.top.photos t.baseX = m.th.rowX + i * m.th.tilePitch m.nodes.Push(t) end for m.list = list m.top.count = list.Count() m.prevIndex = -1 fadeEdge() if m.top.focusIndex >= list.Count() then m.top.focusIndex = list.Count() - 1 onFocusIndex() end sub
sub onFocusIndex() if m.list = invalid then return idx = m.top.focusIndex for i = 0 to m.nodes.Count() - 1 m.nodes[i].focused = (m.top.active and i = idx) end for
' Keep the focused tile at most in the 4th visible slot; never scroll past the first tile. newOffset = m.offset if idx - newOffset > m.th.maxSlot then newOffset = idx - m.th.maxSlot if idx < newOffset then newOffset = idx if newOffset < 0 then newOffset = 0 if newOffset <> m.offset m.slideX.keyValue = [[-m.offset * m.th.tilePitch, 0], [-newOffset * m.th.tilePitch, 0]] m.offset = newOffset fadeEdge() if m.top.reduceMotion m.slider.translation = [-newOffset * m.th.tilePitch, 0] else m.slide.control = "start" end if end if
if m.top.active and idx >= 0 and idx < m.list.Count() m.name.text = m.list[idx].name cx = m.th.rowX + (idx - m.offset) * m.th.tilePitch + m.th.tileW / 2 x = cx - 170 m.namePos.keyValue = [[x, 230], [x, 230], [x, 224]] if idx <> m.prevIndex if m.top.reduceMotion m.name.translation = [x, 224] m.name.opacity = 1 else m.nameIn.control = "start" end if end if else m.name.opacity = 0 end if m.prevIndex = idx end sub
sub onPhotos() if m.list = invalid then return for i = 0 to m.list.Count() - 1 if m.list[i].id = "lumen.memories" then m.nodes[i].photos = m.top.photos end for end sub
' Edit Home (spec 13.4): the user's card order, saved by id; new apps join at the end. function savedOrder(list as object) as object saved = ParseJson(CreateObject("roRegistrySection", "lumen").Read("homeOrder")) if saved = invalid then return list out = [] used = {} for each id in saved for each a in list if a.id = id and used[a.id] = invalid out.Push(a) used[a.id] = true end if end for end for for each a in list if used[a.id] = invalid then out.Push(a) end for return out end function
sub onLifted() if m.nodes = invalid then return i = m.top.focusIndex if i >= 0 and i < m.nodes.Count() then m.nodes[i].lifted = m.top.lifted end sub
' Moves the focused card one place left or right (never past Add app) and saves the order. function moveFocused(d as integer) as integer i = m.top.focusIndex j = i + d last = m.list.Count() - 2 if i > last or j < 0 or j > last then return i a = m.list[i] : m.list[i] = m.list[j] : m.list[j] = a n = m.nodes[i] : m.nodes[i] = m.nodes[j] : m.nodes[j] = n m.nodes[i].baseX = m.th.rowX + i * m.th.tilePitch m.nodes[j].baseX = m.th.rowX + j * m.th.tilePitch ids = [] for k = 0 to last ids.Push(m.list[k].id) end for sec = CreateObject("roRegistrySection", "lumen") sec.Write("homeOrder", FormatJson(ids)) sec.Flush() m.top.focusIndex = j fadeEdge() return j end function
sub onDeep() end sub
' Spec 6.5 right-edge fade. A deep overlay showed as a box over the painting on the TV, ' so tiles past x=1560 dissolve by their own opacity instead. sub fadeEdge() for i = 0 to m.nodes.Count() - 1 x = m.th.rowX + (i - m.offset) * m.th.tilePitch o = (1920 - x) / 360.0 if o > 1 then o = 1 if o < 0 then o = 0 m.nodes[i].opacity = 0.15 + 0.85 * o end for end sub
function current() as object if m.list = invalid then return invalid return m.list[m.top.focusIndex] end function
' Called by MainScene on OK so the focused tile plays its press animation. function pressFocused() as object if m.list = invalid then return invalid t = m.nodes[m.top.focusIndex] if t <> invalid then t.pressed = true return m.list[m.top.focusIndex] end function
' Centre x of the focused tile on screen, for nearest-by-x row changes (spec 11). function focusCenterX() as float return m.th.rowX + (m.top.focusIndex - m.offset) * m.th.tilePitch + m.th.tileW / 2 end function
function indexNearestX(x as float) as integer if m.list = invalid then return 0 best = m.offset bestD = 99999 for i = m.offset to m.list.Count() - 1 cx = m.th.rowX + (i - m.offset) * m.th.tilePitch + m.th.tileW / 2 d = Abs(cx - x) if d < bestD then bestD = d : best = i end for return best end function
